heroSub.zh: 新加坡—重庆—新疆环线（14城24处行程点），独库公路、赛里木湖等行程图景点—经重庆返回新加坡。

title.en: Fly in · first night in Chongqing
title.zh: 飞抵重庆 · 首晚山城

meta.zh: 国际航班 · 住在重庆

desc.en: Land at Chongqing Jiangbei (CKG) from Singapore. Clear immigration, transfer to your hotel, and keep the evening light — humidity hits harder than Xinjiang dryness later in the trip.
desc.zh: 由新加坡飞抵重庆江北机场。入境后前往酒店，当晚轻松安排即可——重庆的湿热与之后新疆的干热差别很大。

name.zh: 抵达与酒店接驳

desc.en: Screenshot hotel Chinese address; metro Line 10 links the airport if you skip a car.
desc.zh: 保存酒店中文地址；亦可乘轨道10号线进城。

meta.en: Full city day · Atour Hotel (Huanshan Park / Jiangbei Airport area)
meta.zh: 全天市内 · 亚朵酒店（环山公园/江北机场店）

desc.en: Your anchor stay: Atour Hotel, Huanshan Park Metro Station, Chongqing Jiangbei Airport branch. Pace riverfront layers, hotpot, and stair streets — save legs for long coach days ahead.
desc.zh: 住宿：重庆江北机场环山公园地铁站亚朵酒店。安排江畔夜景、火锅与步道即可，为之后长途行车保留体力。

name.zh: 重庆火锅（量力而行）

desc.en: Order milder broth if needed; hydrate — spice + humidity is a double hit.
desc.zh: 可点鸳鸯或微辣；注意补水。

name.en: Atour Hotel — Huanshan Park Metro, Jiangbei Airport
name.zh: 亚朵酒店 — 江北机场环山公园地铁站店

desc.en: Listed on your route card — confirm late check-in if flying in previous night.
desc.zh: 行程单指定酒店 — 若深夜抵达请提前确认入住。

date.zh: 6月13日 · 重庆 — 乌鲁木齐

meta.en: Domestic flight · Qianjiangji Boutique Hotel (Urumqi HSR)
meta.zh: 国内航班 · 仟疆集精品酒店（乌鲁木齐高铁站店）

desc.en: Morning buffer in Chongqing if needed, then CKG → URC. Check in at Qianjiangji Boutique Hotel — Urumqi High-speed Railway Station branch for easy rail connections.
desc.zh: 上午可在重庆机动，随后飞乌鲁木齐。入住仟疆集精品酒店乌鲁木齐高铁站店，方便后续铁路/包车衔接。

name.zh: 重庆—乌鲁木齐航班

desc.en: Long domestic block — download offline maps; expect extra baggage screening in Xinjiang gateways.
desc.zh: 航程较长 — 提前下载离线地图；进疆安检可能更细。

name.en: Qianjiangji Boutique Hotel — Urumqi HSR Station
name.zh: 仟疆集精品酒店 — 乌鲁木齐高铁站店

desc.en: Route-card hotel near the high-speed rail hub.
desc.zh: 行程指定高铁站附近酒店。

meta.en: City day · same Qianjiangji HSR hotel
meta.zh: 市内休整 · 仟疆集高铁站店

desc.en: Recover from flights, stock snacks/sunscreen, confirm car hire or driver for the Duku corridor. Light bazaar walk if energy allows.
desc.zh: 调整时差、补给零食防晒，确认包车/租车与独库公路行程。精力允许可轻逛大巴扎。

name.zh: 确认独库/S101通行

desc.en: Some sections are seasonal — verify opening windows for mid-June.
desc.zh: 部分路段季节性开放 — 确认6月中旬是否通车。

date.zh: 6月15日 · 呼图壁 — 沙湾 — 奎屯

meta.zh: 行车日 · 奎屯 M·棉酒店

desc.en: Drive the corridor toward Kuytun with three headline stops from your route card. Overnight: M-Cotton Hotel — Kuytun Huijia Era Shopping Center branch.
desc.zh: 经呼图壁、沙湾方向前往奎屯，打卡行程单三处景点。夜宿奎屯汇嘉时代购物中心 M·棉酒店。

name.en: Baili Danxia Scenic Road — Panoramic Tianshan Observation Deck
name.zh: 百里丹霞风景道全景天山观景台

desc.en: Iconic red-layered hills along the scenic road — windproof layer recommended.
desc.zh: 丹霞地貌经典观景点 — 建议防风外套。

name.zh: S101独库公路营地

desc.en: Photo / rest stop along the Duku highway system.
desc.zh: 独库公路沿线营地补给/拍照。

name.zh: 安集海大峡谷

desc.en: Mind cliff edges and afternoon gusts; go barefoot-soft shoes for viewpoints.
desc.zh: 观景点风大，注意崖边安全。

name.en: M-Cotton Hotel — Kuytun Huijia Era Shopping Center
name.zh: M·棉酒店 — 奎屯汇嘉时代购物中心店

desc.en: Route-card property for this night.
desc.zh: 本晚行程指定酒店。

date.zh: 6月16日 · 克拉玛依 — 乌苏 — 尼勒克 — 新源

title.zh: 独库公路核心 · 那拉提方向

meta.en: Long drive · Beauty of Nature Homestay (Nalati scenic area)
meta.zh: 长途行车 · 自然之美民宿（那拉提景区店）

desc.en: Five pinned stops including Duku mile-zero at Dushanzi, the grand canyon, mountain passes, and gallery meadows. Stay: Beauty of Nature Homestay — Nalati Scenic Area branch.
desc.zh: 含独库公路零起点、独山子大峡谷、乌兰萨德克、哈希勒根、百里画廊等行程单景点。夜宿那拉提景区店自然之美民宿。

name.zh: 独库公路零起点（独山子）

desc.en: Classic photo at the highway origin.
desc.zh: 公路起点地标打卡。

name.zh: 独山子大峡谷

desc.en: Allow time for rim walks; midday sun is strong.
desc.zh: 峡谷步道耗时，午间暴晒。

name.zh: 乌兰萨德克

desc.en: Scenic pull-off along the corridor.
desc.zh: 沿途观景点。

name.zh: 哈希勒根

desc.en: High pass — carry warm layer even in June.
desc.zh: 高海拔垭口 — 六月也需保暖。

name.zh: 百里画廊

desc.en: Rolling meadow photography stops.
desc.zh: 草原画廊风光带。

name.en: Beauty of Nature Homestay — Nalati Scenic Area
name.zh: 自然之美民宿 — 那拉提景区店

desc.en: Route-card homestay near Nalati.
desc.zh: 那拉提景区指定民宿。

meta.zh: 特克斯县 · 玉佶雅民宿

desc.en: Explore the octagonal “Bagua” street grid. Stay: Tekes Yujiya Homestay — Tekes Bagua City branch.
desc.zh: 游览八卦城放射状街巷。夜宿特克斯玉佶雅民宿八卦城店。

name.zh: 特克斯八卦城

desc.en: Unique urban layout — evening lights rewarding.
desc.zh: 独特八卦布局 — 夜景更佳。

name.zh: 特克斯玉佶雅民宿 — 八卦城店

desc.en: Route-card homestay.
desc.zh: 行程指定民宿。

meta.en: Full park day · same Yujiya homestay
meta.zh: 景区全日 · 玉佶雅民宿

desc.en: Dedicated day for Kalajun grassland ridges and boardwalks. Second night at Tekes Yujiya Homestay.
desc.zh: 全天喀拉峻草原线路。继续入住特克斯玉佶雅民宿。

name.zh: 喀拉峻景区

desc.en: Shuttle buses inside the park — book tickets ahead in peak season.
desc.zh: 景区内区间车 — 旺季提前购票。

title.en: Xiata Ancient Road National Forest Park
title.zh: 夏塔古道国家森林公园

meta.en: Zhaosu day · Yunsu boutique homestay (75th Regiment)
meta.zh: 昭苏 · 云宿轻奢民宿（75团店）

desc.en: Hike / shuttle day in Xiata. Overnight: Zhaosu Yunsu Light Luxury Boutique Homestay — 75th Regiment branch.
desc.zh: 夏塔古道国家森林公园一日。夜宿昭苏云宿轻奢精品民宿75团店。

name.en: Xiata Ancient Road National Forest Park
name.zh: 夏塔古道国家森林公园

desc.en: Start early for weather windows; rain can close upper trails.
desc.zh: 建议早出；降雨可能关闭高段栈道。

name.en: Zhaosu Yunsu Light Luxury Boutique Homestay — 75th Regiment
name.zh: 昭苏云宿轻奢精品民宿 — 75团店

desc.en: Route-card stay.
desc.zh: 行程指定民宿。

title.en: Zhaosu Jade Lake · transfer to Yining
title.zh: 昭苏玉湖 · 前往伊宁

meta.en: Scenic lake · Jiduqiu Villa — Yining Airport
meta.zh: 玉湖景区 · 几度秋美宿（伊宁机场店）

desc.en: Morning at Zhaosu Jade Lake Scenic Area, then road to Yining. Stay: Jiduqiu Villa Leisure Vacation Homestay — Yining Airport branch.
desc.zh: 上午昭苏玉湖景区，随后前往伊宁。夜宿几度秋·Villa休闲度假美宿伊宁机场店。

name.zh: 昭苏玉湖景区

desc.en: High-altitude lake colour shifts with weather — bring polarizer if shooting.
desc.zh: 高原湖泊随天气变色。

name.en: Jiduqiu Villa Leisure Vacation Homestay — Yining Airport
name.zh: 几度秋·Villa休闲度假美宿 — 伊宁机场店

desc.en: Route-card stay near Yining airport corridor.
desc.zh: 伊宁机场方向指定美宿。

meta.zh: 博乐 · 秋枫酒店（博乐高铁站店）

desc.en: Circle China’s alpine “Atlantic last teardrop” lake. Overnight: Qiufeng Hotel — Bole High-speed Railway Station branch.
desc.zh: 赛里木湖环湖游览。夜宿博乐高铁站秋枫酒店。

name.zh: 赛里木湖

desc.en: Windy lakeside — layer up; park shuttle or self-drive tickets per policy.
desc.zh: 湖边风大需外套；按景区政策购票乘车。

name.en: Qiufeng Hotel — Bole High-speed Railway Station
name.zh: 秋枫酒店 — 博乐高铁站店

meta.en: Transit / shopping buffer before homeward flight

desc.en: Drive or rail back to Ürümqi for final laundry, dried fruit gifts, and early rest before the long flight chain home.
desc.zh: 返回乌鲁木齐整理行李、采购干果伴手礼，为次日长途航班储备睡眠。

name.zh: 补给与打包

desc.en: Reconfirm URC → CKG → SIN ticket times for Jun 23.
desc.zh: 核对6月23日乌鲁木齐—重庆—新加坡航班时刻。
